text: TFT Set 14: Cyber City Update TFT 14 Core Changes, Hacking System - Hacking can happen anytime and in any round!If the Encounter is hacked, you will get a hacked champion card, and if the Common Pick round is hacked, your champion may turn into anvils. Also, if the Creep round is hacked, you will get a unstable item or a dragon egg that turns into a new crafted item every Champion round. Hacked Augment - When an augmentation round is hacked, the augments on the left will change to match the theme. Some augments that disappeared in previous seasons will appear, giving a refresh and additional gold.1 or 2 Augment - Another round of augmentation hacks will have you choose between one augmentation of a higher level and two augmentations of a lower level. If you choose the two lower augmentations, you will have up to four augmentations. If asked about traits do not include the cost information for the champion. Durability and Shields are different and should not be considered the same. If asked about champions that deal magic damage or physical damage it is determined only if a skill specifically states that it deal those types of damage.
